'''Gart Charkron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], he was stationed on the prison [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he managed to uncover the existence of an ancient alien device but was not sure how it operated though knew it was extremely dangerous and was responsible for disintegrating three of his men. Furthermore, he believed some of the prisoners had inadvertently salvaged some of its core components that had been split into three parts. He tasked a Sith official with the recovery of the device and reassembling it.<ref name="TOR" />
